text: I still stand by the fact that my husband is the ugliest man that I have ever met five years into our marriage. If you are single right now, it's because you want to be attracted to your partner and that is just not realistic. I don't know how many times women on this app are going to have to say it. Find an ugly ass man and marry him. And I'm not talking about a guy that just needs a little brush up. Okay. I'm talking about a terminally unattractive man. I sleep with an eye mask at night so that I have time in the morning to mentally prepare before I make eye contact with my husband. But here I am married and you're not. So who's laughing? Okay. Who is going to show this video to her husband? But you know what's even crazier? Her husband probably already knows about it and he's still with her. He's okay with this level of disrespect and that's exactly why she says it so confidently. She's like, I can call him ugly on the internet and he's still here. So I must be right. That is the problem. When you tolerate disrespect, it only grows. Imagine being married to someone who says she has to mentally prepare before looking at you. That's not humor. That's humiliation. Guys, this is simple. In a relationship, you should be the best person for your partner. If your girl doesn't see you as the best, if she settles for you or openly calls you ugly, get out. Don't stay with someone who is ashamed of you. But there's a catch. You also have to be working on yourself. Level up, take care of your appearance, your mindset, your career, your life. You can't just exist, not work on yourself and naively expect that there is a girl out there who will like you the way you are. And ladies, this goes both ways. You should be a person your man goes crazy about. And you should be with a man you are actually crazy about, not someone you think is ugly but safe. So yeah, guys, don't tolerate disrespect from your partner. Your self-worth comes first. If your partner doesn't see you as the best, but as someone they settle for, stop trying to convince them. Just leave. Find someone who looks at you like you are the best thing that ever happened to them.
